name: Robot Automatic Backplane Screw Machine
summary: Capable of grabbing and automatically tightening up to 12 back panel screws at once, with real-time adjustable torque per screw, achieving an efficiency of 1.8 seconds per screw.
contentHtml:
The robotic automatic back panel screw machine is an automation device developed by TXAM for precision fastening processes.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a robot combined with an intelligent fastening system, capable of grabbing 12 screws at once and automatically fastening them onto the product. Torque is adjustable in real time to ensure consistent fastening torque for each screw.

Technical Advantages

  • Can grab 12 screws at once, reducing feeding frequency
  • Fastening speed of 1.8 seconds per screw, extremely efficient
  • Real-time adjustable torque ensures fastening quality
  • Suitable for back panel fastening of TVs, educational monitors, etc.
